# argument acceptability

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:argumentAcceptability`](gmeow-argumentAcceptability.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/argumentAcceptability>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A numerical acceptability score for an argument or standpoint claim. Solver-layer computation ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)), referencing AIF (Argument Interchange Format).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) -> [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal)

Use [`gmeow:argumentAcceptability`](gmeow-argumentAcceptability.md) from [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) to [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry a solver-computed acceptability figure for a [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) within an argumentation graph (AIF) — a derived scalar ranking how well a claim survives attack and support.

### Avoid when

- Avoid hand-authoring it (it is a solver-layer derivation, [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)) and avoid conflating acceptability with truth — a well-defended claim may still be untrue; refute a [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md)'s modality to settle falsehood, never lower this score.

### How to use

- Let the argumentation solver write the [xsd:decimal](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) acceptability onto the [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) from the AIF attack/support structure; keep the underlying argument graph in the solver layer rather than encoding it as OWL axioms.

### Examples

- ex:claim [`gmeow:argumentAcceptability`](gmeow-argumentAcceptability.md) 0.8.
